{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the correct column name for disease severity
print("Unique values in 'severity' column:")
print(df['severity'].unique())

# Check for sentinel values in baseline biomarker
print("\nBaseline biomarker values (first 10):")
print(df['biomarker_baseline'].head(10))

# Check for sentinel values (e.g., -999.0) in baseline biomarker
sentinel_value = -999.0
print(f"\nNumber of rows with sentinel value ({sentinel_value}) in baseline biomarker:")
print((df['biomarker_baseline'] == sentinel_value).sum())

# Filter for SEVERE disease at baseline
severe_patients = df[df['severity'] == 'severe']

# Check the number of severe patients
print(f"\nNumber of patients with SEVERE disease: {len(severe_patients)}")

# Check baseline biomarker values for severe patients
print("\nBaseline biomarker values for SEVERE patients (first 10):")
print(severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'].head(10))

# Compute mean baseline biomarker value for SEVERE patients
mean_biomarker_severe = severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'].mean()
print(f"\nMean baseline biomarker value for SEVERE patients: {mean_biomarker_severe}")"}
